literal: If internal enmity arises by way of relationship, it will bring many afflictions by way of ruin.
translation: If internal enmity arises among those who are closely related, it will bring many fatal afflictions that lead to utter ruin.
modern: உறவினர் போன்ற நெருங்கிய முறையில் உட்பகை உண்டானால், அது அழிவை உண்டாக்கும் வழியில் பல துன்பங்களைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet warns of the extreme danger of secret hatred arising among close associates or relatives. The word 'uṟal-muṟaiyāṉ' refers to the manner of close relationship, indicating that the enemy is disguised as a close ally. The word 'iṟal-muṟaiyāṉ' mirrors this structure, meaning 'by way of ruin or death'. The poet emphasizes that when hatred develops within one's own circle, it does not just cause minor setbacks; instead, it systematically delivers numerous fatal afflictions that inevitably lead to complete destruction.
